147217.overview: Tails, the double-tailed fox, takes children in a musical trip : they will discover many instruments, the basics of rhythm and tempo. An animated keyboard lets them play their own tracks, an special pinball shows the different percussion sounds. A basic editor using Sonic universe characters would even let them create their own cartoons, dubbed by their musical creation.

147438.overview:
Tomica Pico: Rescue Parking (トミカ・ピコ レスキューパーキング) is a Sega Pico package which shipped with a Tomica Pico accessory and the game, Kinkyuu Shutsudou! Hataraku Norimono (きんきゅうしゅつどう！ はたらくのりもの), which was not sold separately.

In Limited edition, three minicar was shipped. Models are Mazda RX-7 Police Car, Nissan ambulance, and Hino fire Engine. Normal version is police car only. The three vehicles were released by Tomica separately, albeit without Pico branding.
